title: Felt
summary: A back-room blackjack pit. Your chip stack is the high score.
description:
Felt is a single-deck table in a room that keeps the lights low. Set a stake, take a hit, or stand and let the dealer play to 17. Aces count as 11 when they can, and 1 when they must.

The chips in front of you are the score. A bigger stack beats a smaller one on the rankings, and the best stack you have ever held stays on this machine.
whatsNew: Shady pit lighting, chip high scores, and a rankings board.

reviews.name: Jonah Abe
reviews.body: I only wanted one hand. The dealer showing a six is a trap and I know it.

reviews.name: Soe Nandar
reviews.body: Posted my stack and it sat above the room. That is the only reason I stayed for another shoe.
